1. Why apply

Trade prices are for people who buy for work: plumbers, builders, cabinet makers, joiners, renovators and designers. Send us your business details and we email you a trade code. The current trade offer is in the Pricing section of the home page.

Buying for a whole job? Build a project list and we quote it in one go.

2. Apply

What do you do?

Your details are saved privately for FI and emailed to the team. See the privacy notice.

Application received.

One of the founders checks your ABN and replies within 48 hours. If you are approved, your trade code comes by email.

Browse the shop ↗

3. How we check

  1. The form checks your ABN has the right number of digits and passes the official check-digit test. This catches typing mistakes. It does not prove the ABN is yours.
  2. A founder looks it up on the Australian Business Register and confirms the name matches.
  3. We email your code. If we cannot confirm the ABN we tell you why.
